Our Work · Pillar 03

Policy, Governance & Public Leadership

Connecting knowledge and innovation to policymaking — governance, diplomacy, policy advisory, and leadership dialogues.

Policy advisory

From 2028: structured advisory programs with ministries, universities, cities, regional institutions, and development agencies.

Governance & institutions

Evidence-based, context-sensitive policy design — strengthening the institutional interfaces between research and decision-making.

Diplomacy & cooperation

Research–policy interfaces that support diplomacy, South–South cooperation, and international engagement. Government relations

Leadership dialogues

GPS Dialogues, policy forums, roundtables, and university–government exchanges — spaces where decisions meet evidence. Join a dialogue

Policy publications

Policy briefs and advisory notes designed for uptake — short, actionable, and grounded. Policy briefs

Public leadership training

Diplomatic and policy training and leadership development through the GPS Academy — for serving and emerging public leaders.

Interconnected by design

Policy that listens — and leads.

Policy draws evidence from research and working examples from innovation and enterprise. And it leads in return: policy can stimulate innovation, open markets, and set the research agenda. The bridge carries traffic both ways.

← Knowledge: evidence↔ Innovation: pilots & regulation↔ Enterprise: enabling environments
